# Operator configuration

<!-- Generated by sdo/operator/cmd/configdoc from contracts/settings; do not edit. Run scripts/gen_config_docs.sh. -->

Operator configuration is how long SDO waits and how it responds. App memory (`.sdo/`) decides what counts as broken;
nothing here changes what an accepted detector decides.

## Setting it

`sdo-operator host` and `sdo-operator install-existing` resolve one configuration, in this order (later wins):

1. the defaults in this file;
2. each `--config FILE` (YAML, repeatable, applied in order; an unknown key is an error);
3. `SDO_<SECTION>_<KEY>` environment variables, derived from the YAML key path (the top-level `mode` is `SDO_MODE`).
   A list or an object is JSON. A variable that starts with a section prefix but names no key is an error;
4. the pre-config command-line flags, when explicitly given (they are being removed).

The installer writes the resolved result to the `sdo-config` ConfigMap, mounted read-only at `/etc/sdo/config.yaml` in the
operate and controller Jobs. Its hash is part of the controller's install fingerprint, so running `install-existing` again with
a changed configuration replaces the controller. The controller also records the file under `.sdo-runtime/config.yaml`,
which the evidence sink carries to the run directory.

`sdo-operator config print [--config FILE]...` prints the resolved YAML.

For one release, `host` and `install-existing` refuse to start while `SDO_CODE_PATH` or `SDO_RESPONDER_MENU` is set in their
environment; use `SDO_AGENT_CODE_PATH` and `SDO_RESPONSE_MENU`.

## Keys

### Top level

| Key | Env | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `SDO_MODE` | enum | `operate` | how incidents are handled: operate (respond and learn), frozen (respond, learn nothing), watch-only (detect and verify, never respond) or external (external alerts only, close on responder completion) |

### `agent`

| Key | Env | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `agent.provider` | `SDO_AGENT_PROVIDER` | string | `codex` | agent provider of every worker: codex or claude |
| `agent.model` | `SDO_AGENT_MODEL` | string | `""` | agent model of every worker (required) |
| `agent.effort` | `SDO_AGENT_EFFORT` | string | `medium` | reasoning effort of every worker: low, medium, high, xhigh or max |
| `agent.lifecycle_timeout` | `SDO_AGENT_LIFECYCLE_TIMEOUT` | duration | `15m0s` | limit of one lifecycle (detection designer) session |
| `agent.memory_check_timeout` | `SDO_AGENT_MEMORY_CHECK_TIMEOUT` | duration | `5m0s` | limit of one memory check a worker runs on its checkout |
| `agent.code_path` | `SDO_AGENT_CODE_PATH` | string | `go` | programming-model plugin set: go or shell |
| `agent.code_path_overrides` | `SDO_AGENT_CODE_PATH_OVERRIDES` | string | `""` | CodePathOverrides as a JSON object; empty selects the code path's own stages |
| `agent.extra_env` | `SDO_AGENT_EXTRA_ENV` | list (JSON) | `[]` | extra NAME=VALUE environment of responder workers |

### `response`

| Key | Env | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `response.timeout` | `SDO_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT` | duration | `30m0s` | how long the responder may work on one incident; the reflection deadline derives from it |
| `response.verification_timeout` | `SDO_RESPONSE_VERIFICATION_TIMEOUT` | duration | `5m0s` | how long the independent verification of a repair may take |
| `response.max_loops` | `SDO_RESPONSE_MAX_LOOPS` | int | `10` | mitigation rounds the responder agent may use per incident (the automatic stage's one apply does not count) |
| `response.diagnosis_deadline` | `SDO_RESPONSE_DIAGNOSIS_DEADLINE` | duration | `10s` | shared deadline of candidate diagnosis in the automatic stage |
| `response.repair_policy` | `SDO_RESPONSE_REPAIR_POLICY` | string | `commit` | repair evidence policy: commit (a source repair is committed) or recorded-actions (live repairs are recorded without a source commit) |
| `response.standby` | `SDO_RESPONSE_STANDBY` | bool | `true` | pre-start a responder worker; false forces cold Jobs |
| `response.menu` | `SDO_RESPONSE_MENU` | bool | `true` | offer the responder its tool menu |
| `response.permissive` | `SDO_RESPONSE_PERMISSIVE` | bool | `false` | broad lane repair permissions excluding Secret and credential APIs |
| `response.permissive_namespaces` | `SDO_RESPONSE_PERMISSIVE_NAMESPACES` | list (JSON) | `[]` | additional lane namespaces the permissive responder may repair |

### `learning`

| Key | Env | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `learning.replay` | `SDO_LEARNING_REPLAY` | string | `on` | replay and corpus capture: on or off |
| `learning.reflection_guidance` | `SDO_LEARNING_REFLECTION_GUIDANCE` | string | `baseline` | reflection guidance: baseline, generalize or generalize-spec |
| `learning.force_reflection` | `SDO_LEARNING_FORCE_REFLECTION` | bool | `false` | always dispatch reflection after a verified closure (not with a frozen mode) |
| `learning.healthy_baseline` | `SDO_LEARNING_HEALTHY_BASELINE` | bool | `false` | validate incident detectors against recorded healthy snapshots |
| `learning.late_findings` | `SDO_LEARNING_LATE_FINDINGS` | string | `off` | late finding mode: off or pull |

### `deployment`

| Key | Env | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `deployment.max_attempts` | `SDO_DEPLOYMENT_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | int | `3` | maximum deployment attempts |
| `deployment.build_timeout` | `SDO_DEPLOYMENT_BUILD_TIMEOUT` | duration | `30m0s` | deadline of one source image build |
| `deployment.build_budget` | `SDO_DEPLOYMENT_BUILD_BUDGET` | duration | `1h0m0s` | deadline of all source image builds of one deployment attempt |
| `deployment.rollout_timeout` | `SDO_DEPLOYMENT_ROLLOUT_TIMEOUT` | duration | `10m0s` | how long to wait for each applied workload to finish rolling out |
| `deployment.policy` | `SDO_DEPLOYMENT_POLICY` | object (JSON) | `{}` | install-time deployment policy as a JSON object (registry allowlist, scope blocking and grants) |

### `evidence`

| Key | Env | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `evidence.host_path` | `SDO_EVIDENCE_HOST_PATH` | string | `""` | node directory that receives run evidence (writable by uid 65532); outlives the control namespace |
| `evidence.volume` | `SDO_EVIDENCE_VOLUME` | string | `""` | evidence sink as a Kubernetes VolumeSource JSON; excludes host_path |
| `evidence.run_id` | `SDO_EVIDENCE_RUN_ID` | string | `""` | run directory inside the evidence sink (empty: the control namespace) |

### `telemetry`

| Key | Env | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `telemetry.profile` | `SDO_TELEMETRY_PROFILE` | string | `prometheus-default` | application telemetry profile: a built-in name (prometheus-default, none), a YAML or JSON file, or an inline JSON document |
| `telemetry.sources` | `SDO_TELEMETRY_SOURCES` | list (JSON) | `[]` | operator-provided external Prometheus-compatible metrics sources as ID=URL; the first becomes the default when the profile has none |

## App-memory defaults

These are not operator configuration. Each is authored per detector or probe in app memory; the SDK constant is the
fallback when a field is left unset.

| Value | Fallback | Source |
|---|---|---|
| probe health minimum duration | `9s` | `traffic.DefaultHealthMinDuration` |
| probe SLO window (samples) | `5` | `traffic.DefaultWindow` |
| probe SLO minimum samples | `3` | `traffic.DefaultMinSamples` |
| probe SLO maximum sample age | `30s` | `traffic.DefaultMaxAge` |
| probe SLO maximum error rate | `0.5` | `traffic.DefaultMaxErrorRate` |
| probe SLO maximum timeout rate | `0.5` | `traffic.DefaultMaxTimeoutRate` |
| probe SLO maximum latency | `1.5s` | `traffic.DefaultMaxLatency` |

## Internal worker variables

These are written by the controller into worker Jobs, or read by `sdo-operator memory check` inside workers. They are
transport, not knobs, and keep their names.

- `SDO_AGENT_GUIDANCE`
- `SDO_RESPONSE_CONTINUATION`
- `SDO_DEPLOYMENT_MODEL`
- `SDO_TELEMETRY_POLICY`
- `SDO_AGENT_SCRIPT_*`
- `SDO_TASK_PATH`
- `SDO_INCIDENT_ID`
- `SDO_REPLAY`
- `SDO_CODE_PATH`
- `SDO_RESPONDER_MENU`
